thread:
maria: Heads-up: we need a planned maintenance window for az5 GPUs next Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC. Rolling reboots across 4 cohorts to apply NIC microcode + driver hotfix. Affects hosted and dedicated pools in az5 only. :warning:
alex: estimated impact? percent of capacity?
jia: current az5 GPU capacity is ~420 cards, we'll cordon ~10% per cohort (42 cards). Canary will be 4 GPUs first.
maria: plan: cohort size 42, stagger 20m between cohorts, canary 02:05 for 30m, then proceed if telemetry looks good. Backfill from us-west1 if needed.
sam: can we pre-seed KV cache before cut to avoid cold-cache latency spike?
jia: yes – we'll run kvseed job 45m before each cohort start. Command: `./tooling/kvseed --region=az5 --cohort=$COHORT --warmup=1800`
ops-sre: routing: we'll tag affected nodes with maintenance label so smart-routing avoids them. Need to update fallback weights for 20m window.
natalie: customer comms? enterprise customers on dedicated in az5 need notice. I'll send an email template.
maria: cost tradeoff: expected short-term burst on us-west1 (~10% extra token cost) while backfilling, roughly $1.2k/hr estimate if fully backfilled.
alex: any tests to run after driver apply? perf/regression checks?
jia: yes, run perf smoke: `scripts/perf-check --model=gpt-medium --seq=512 --qps=5` and quality: `evals/run_eval.sh az5-canary-prompts`
infra-oncall-bot: Scheduled maintenance created: maintenance/az5-2026-02-xx (id m-7054321). Notifying oncall schedule.
ops-sre: Oncall coverage: maria + ops-sre primary, alex + sam standby. Will set pager thresholds to lower for first cohort.
sam: rollback playbook? if driver fails, we revert using node image rollback + drain cancel: `kubectl uncordon <node>` then `image-rollback --id=<previous>`
maria: post-mortem checklist: metrics (p99 latency, svc errors), KV cache hitrate, GPU utilization and OOM logs. We'll keep 60m post-cohort observation.
alex: can we shorten cohort if telemetry stable? propose early proceed after 15m stable metrics. agree?
jia: agree, but keep min 15m watch and run smoke perf.
natalie: drafting comms now, will ping legal for enterprise SLAs.
ops-sre: I'll open temporary capacity reservations on us-west1 to cap backfill costs if traffic spikes.
maria: final action items: jia -> run kvseed + perf checks; alex -> routing weight bump + thresholds; ops-sre -> reservations + pager; natalie -> comms. Tagging @here for visibility. :thumbsup:
infra-oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: maintenance/az5-2026-02-xx starts in 24 hours.
maria: thanks all — will post playbook in this thread 1hr before start.
